questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Show summary' with 'Total earnings', 'Sold 164 lots' and an Orders list says what the page is for.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: No primary action; the 'Go to Lot' field is pushed to the far right and the order rows are equal weight.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Orders', 'Performance' and the 'All / Lots / Buy Now / Giveaways' chips predict their content.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'UNSOLD', 'UNPAID' and 'Won by @pokefan99' are terms a live seller knows.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Only filtering choices, made from information the seller has.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Each row shows the full 'Order ID: O181d7792-…' UUID up front.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Stats and orders both belong to the after-show review.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Rows read quickly, but the UUID line on every order is text to scan past.
